title: TradeAgreement
description: Sales contract or sale confirmation for a goods shipment, issued by the seller. Covers commodity trade contracts, where quantity, quality and price are stated per lot. All values are copied from the document — never computed, never converted between units.

date_order.description: Order of day/month/year in the dates printed on this document; 'unknown' when no date is printed

decimal_style.description: How decimal numbers are printed on this document: point_decimal (1,234.56) or comma_decimal (1.234,56); 'unknown' when no number reveals it

document_conventions.description: FIRST, before extracting any value: classify the document's printed date and number conventions

contract_number.description: Reference labeled as the contract or confirmation number itself; null when the document prints only party-specific references

seller_reference.description: The seller's own reference for this contract, e.g. from a 'Seller's Ref No.' field

buyer_reference.description: The buyer's reference exactly as printed, including a placeholder such as 'TBA' when that is what is printed

contract_date.description: Date the contract or confirmation was issued — the date exactly as printed; do NOT reformat

trade_date.description: Date the sale was concluded, from a phrase such as 'we confirm having sold on …'; null when the document prints no separate trade date — the date exactly as printed; do NOT reformat

address.description: The party's address block exactly as printed: every address line (street, postal/city, country) verbatim and in printed order. Preserve line breaks as newline characters when the lines are stacked; when the address is printed on a single line, copy that line with its separators as-is. When the only location printed for the party is a country name, that country name IS the address block: copy it here and keep it out of the name field. EXCLUDE labeled non-address lines such as 'VAT: …', 'Tel …' or an email address — those have their own fields

tax_ids.description: Every tax registration printed for this party, any jurisdiction; null when none is printed

label.description: Tax-ID label exactly as printed before the value, e.g. 'VAT', 'PIN No', 'USCI', 'Tax ID'

value.description: Tax registration number exactly as printed

phone.description: Phone number exactly as printed — never reformatted to international notation

Preserve line breaks as newline characters when the lines are stacked; when the address is printed on a single line, copy that line with its separators as-is. When the only location printed for the party is a country name, that country name IS the address block: copy it here and keep it out of the name field. EXCLUDE labeled non-address lines such as 'VAT: …', 'Tel …' or an email address — those have their own fields

label.description: Tax-ID label exactly as printed before the value, e.g. 'VAT', 'PIN No', 'USCI', 'Tax ID'

value.description: Tax registration number exactly as printed

address.description: The party's address block exactly as printed: every address line (street, postal/city, country) verbatim and in printed order. Preserve line breaks as newline characters when the lines are stacked; when the address is printed on a single line, copy that line with its separators as-is. When the only location printed for the party is a country name, that country name IS the address block: copy it here and keep it out of the name field. EXCLUDE labeled non-address lines such as 'VAT: …', 'Tel …' or an email address — those have their own fields

broker.description: Broker or intermediary named on the contract; null when none is named

commodity.description: The traded commodity ONLY when explicitly printed as its own statement; never inferred from a letterhead or a goods description

total_package_count.description: Total number of packages sold under this contract — exactly as printed, including any spelled-out form

package_type.description: Kind of package exactly as printed, e.g. BAGS, CARTONS, DRUMS

weight_per_package.description: Weight of a single package as printed in the quantity statement, e.g. 60 from "320 Bags of 60 kg net" — the number exactly as printed, keeping separators; no units

weight_per_package_unit.description: Unit of the per-package weight exactly as printed, e.g. kg, lbs

weight_basis.description: Basis qualifier printed with the quantity or terms, e.g. 'net', 'net shipping weight', 'gross'; null when not printed

currency.description: Currency of the contract when stated once for the whole document; null when only per-lot currencies are printed

lots.description: One entry per quality/price line, in printed order. A single-line contract still yields one entry

lot_reference.description: Lot, outturn or contract-part reference exactly as printed, e.g. 'ctr/742'

package_count.description: Number of packages in this lot — exactly as printed, including any spelled-out form

package_type.description: Kind of package for this lot exactly as printed

quality_grade.description: Quality grade or classification exactly as printed, e.g. 'AB', 'PB', 'AA'; null when the lot states no grade

description.description: Goods, mark or estate description for this lot as printed, excluding the grade and the quantity

unit_price.description: Price figure printed for this lot, without currency or unit — the amount exactly as printed, keeping thousand and decimal separators; no currency symbols or units

price_per_quantity.description: The quantity the price applies to, e.g. 50 from "USD 290/50 kgs". This is frequently NOT the package weight — copy what is printed — the number exactly as printed, keeping separators; no units

price_per_unit.description: Unit the price applies to exactly as printed, e.g. kgs, lb, MT

incoterm.description: Delivery term printed on this lot line — exactly as printed, the three-letter rule or its spelled-out name

conditions.description: Conditions the sale is subject to, verbatim, e.g. 'SUBJECT TO APPROVAL OF SAMPLES'; null when the document states none

packaging.description: Packing specification ONLY from an explicitly labeled packing/packaging field; null when packing is stated inside another line

delivery_terms.description: The delivery/terms line verbatim, including any wording beyond the Incoterms rule itself

rule.description: Incoterms rule governing the sale — exactly as printed, the three-letter rule or its spelled-out name

named_place.description: Named place or port following the rule, exactly as printed; null when no place is printed with the rule

incoterms.description: Incoterms rule and its named place; null if the document states no delivery term

insurance.description: Insurance arrangement as printed, e.g. 'For Buyers Account'; null when not stated

shipment_period.description: Shipment or delivery period. When the printed period has been struck through and replaced by hand, this is the REPLACEMENT value and the struck original belongs in amendments — exactly as printed; do NOT reformat, and do NOT invent a day when only a month is printed

name.description: Port name exactly as printed, name portion only — from 'ROTTERDAM, NETHERLANDS' copy 'ROTTERDAM'; never reformatted

country.description: Port country — the country exactly as printed (name or code), ONLY when printed; never inferred from an address

destination.description: Destination place or port of delivery

country_of_origin.description: The goods' origin country from an explicitly printed origin field — the country exactly as printed (name or code), ONLY when printed; never inferred from an address

total_amount.description: Total contract value as printed; null when the document prints no total — the amount exactly as printed, keeping thousand and decimal separators; no currency symbols or units

signatories.description: Acceptance and signature lines in printed order; null when the document has none

party_name.description: Name printed on the acceptance or signature line

role.description: Role label printed with the line, e.g. 'Accepted', 'Seller', 'Buyer'; null when only a name is printed

signed.description: true when a handwritten signature, initials or a stamp is present on this line; false when the line is blank

amendments.description: Alterations made to the printed document by hand or stamp: struck-through values, handwritten replacements, inserted text. null when the document carries none

field_label.description: Label of the field that was altered, exactly as printed

original_value.description: The printed value that was struck through or overwritten, as far as it remains legible; null when illegible

amended_value.description: The handwritten or stamped replacement value, verbatim

initialled.description: true when initials or a signature accompany the alteration

stamps.description: Ink or rubber-stamp impressions on the document, one entry per stamp. Never the printed letterhead, never a handwritten signature; null when the document carries no stamp

text.description: The full stamp text verbatim, newline-separated where the impression is stacked

party_name.description: Organisation named inside the stamp; null when it names none

date.description: Date printed inside the stamp; null when it carries none — the date exactly as printed; do NOT reformat

additional_references.description: Labeled references or identifiers printed on the document that have NO dedicated field in this schema. A reference already placed in contract_number, seller_reference or buyer_reference MUST NOT be repeated here, and neither may a party's phone, email or address line. Fiscal-device serials and delivery-note numbers are the kind of thing that belongs here; null when there are none

label.description: The reference's label exactly as printed

value.description: The reference's value exactly as printed

notes.description: Content of an explicitly labeled notes/remarks box ONLY. Never footer or certification boilerplate. null when the box is empty or shows '—'

iso-4217.description: Currency exactly as printed — code, symbol or abbreviation (EUR, US$, Ksh, ...), verbatim.

un-locode.description: Five-character UN/LOCODE exactly as printed, ONLY if explicitly printed on the document. Never derive it from a port or place name; emit null when no code is printed.
